sources.name: EA stack monitoring collection
facts: four guidance documents define overall stack monitoring approach
covers MCERTS, method hierarchy, sampling strategy and uncertainty

sources.name: EA periodic monitoring techniques and standards
facts: includes biogenic/fossil derived CO2 ratio and carbon dioxide
MIDs are used to apply standards consistently

sources.name: EA continuous monitoring and sampling
facts: covers CEMS, DAHS, LTS and PEMS quality assurance
biogenic CO2 can be measured using long-term samplers
typical time-integrated sample period is 28 days and analysis can use accelerator mass spectrometry, liquid scintillation or beta ionization

sources.name: EA selecting a monitoring approach
facts: periodic and continuous monitoring are distinct approaches
MCERTS stack monitoring organisations need EN ISO/IEC 17025 plus certified personnel and site-specific protocols

global_operations: EA monitoring hierarchy and QA sources agree
Periodic, CEMS, LTS and PEMS are not treated as interchangeable
Stack method guidance alone does not establish parcel emissions
